criteria.description: Terminology: five accurate definitions/analogies worth 2 each (1 meaning, 1 analogy with mapping).

criteria.feedback: Missing or incorrect prediction. Trace the example and check JSON types, then retry.

criteria.description: List products, customers and sales with collection/detail URLs. Use stable IDs, and explain why a sale deserves its own resource. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Create api-contract.md covering list, detail, create, update and delete products. Specify method, URL, request fields, success status and error status for each. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Require nonblank name, integer price >=0 and integer stock >=0. Give one accepted JSON body and four rejected bodies with field-specific errors. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Design a page size of 2 for five sample products. Write all three response pages and correct next/previous values. Keep ordering explicit by ID. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Specify low-stock and name-search query parameters and allowed ordering fields. Give an example matching two records and define unknown parameter behaviour. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Design POST /sales/ with product ID and quantity. Specify insufficient-stock handling, unchanged stock after failure, and how clients learn the updated stock. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).

Add a new optional product field without removing existing fields. Compare that with renaming id, explain which clients break, and write a migration/versioning note. Mark: implementation/artefact meets stated requirements (6); demonstrated stated cases with actual output (3); explanation of the result (1).
Independent verification: new normal case (3), boundary/failure case (3), reproducible commands and observed outputs (2), limitation and repair plan (2).
